title: CookbookCore: updateItem(atLine:newText:)
description: Add `public mutating func updateItem(atLine lineIndex: Int, newText: String)` to `ShoppingList.swift`. Replaces the text portion of the checklist line at `lineIndex` with `newText` (verbatim), preserving the bracket state (`[ ]` / `[x]`). No-op if the target line is not a checklist item (same guard as `removeItem`). No other lines in `text` are modified.
acceptance_criteria: Method signature is `public mutating func updateItem(atLine lineIndex: Int, newText: String)`
Given `- [ ] *300 g* broccoli` at index 1, calling updateItem(atLine: 1, newText: "*500 g* spinach") yields `- [ ] *500 g* spinach`
Given `- [x] foo` at index 0, calling updateItem(atLine: 0, newText: "bar") yields `- [x] bar` (bracket unchanged)
Calling updateItem on a `## heading` line leaves text byte-identical
All lines outside the targeted line are byte-identical after the call
